_about: Hand-entered activity rates (source: manual) from public web figures, for attractions the workbook does not price. Per adult, INR, Indian resident. They conflict between sources and none is an official tariff, so each is an estimate for agency review: replace with a supplier rate or a workbook row. Dirang Dzong is free per two listings (Rs 0, not an official tariff). Nag Temple and Monpa Village: no ticket is published; priced Rs 0 on that basis, each flagged as an estimate. Tipi Orchid Research Centre is already in the workbook (about Rs 189), which wins; web figures for it range Rs 10 to Rs 50, so the workbook is the higher, safer number.
